card.name: Inside citations and reference entries
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits inside bibliographic references, such as journal issue colons, DOI or URL numbers, and the period after a textbook title. Also seen in news phrases citing where findings were reported.

modes.label: Citation punctuation and digits
modes.description: A colon, period or digit within a journal, textbook or URL reference.

modes.label: Digits in identifiers
modes.description: A single digit inside a DOI, report number or web address.

modes.label: Reporting of findings
modes.description: A word in a news sentence saying where scientists reported results.
